ABOUT HEALTHGUARD

Privacy Should Never Be A Trade-Off.

HealthGuard transforms health insurance through mathematical cryptography. By pairing Circom Groth16 Zero-Knowledge Proofs with Solidity Smart Contracts and AES-256-GCM encrypted off-chain storage, patients retain absolute sovereignty over their medical history while insurers verify eligibility with mathematical certainty.

Zero Data Exposure

Diagnosis codes, medication history, and clinical notes are never revealed to insurers or stored on public chains.

Anti-Replay Nullifiers

Cryptographic nullifiers derived from patient salts and claim timestamps permanently prevent duplicate submissions.

Trustless Settlement

Solidity smart contracts automatically release payouts to authorized hospital wallets the instant a Groth16 proof validates.
